title: Installer-built Joomla quickstarts are owed the showcase phase, and a phase that left every owner as it was settles failed
steps: S1: Run node --test on packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/joomla-contract-bind.test.mjs and wordpress-quickstart.test.mjs; read the results of the four named tests.
expect: S1: every named test passes: an installer-shaped quickstart this run builds writes the receipt and the bind runs the phase; a resumed build keeps its request id; a re-run on a built site is not owed the phase; a status whose skipped object names every owner as left settles the phase failed, not applied.
evidence: Dev matrix after #1674: JA Fresco j6 built through the installer kept its showcase (no receipt); JA Diner wp7 logged applied while every navigation was a conflict
fence: Provisioning scripts under test doubles; the plugin's URL-rewrite comparison is covered by the claude-cowork suites

tests: owners the status leaves as they were are named; all of them left is a failed phase, not applied
an installer-shaped quickstart this run builds is owed its showcase phase, and the bind runs it
an installer-shaped quickstart resumed before its build finished keeps the request id it was given
a re-run on an installer-shaped site already built is not owed the phase, and says so
